scope: Generic post-release LayerCake host control for an immutable provenance-bound destination label. The control is additive and is outside the sealed Phase 0-8 product.

behavioral_boundary.registered_destination: May invoke only the package registered for the immutable outer destination label.
behavioral_boundary.missing_or_unknown_destination: Fails closed without invoking the English core or any package.
behavioral_boundary.quarantine_destination: Fails closed without invoking the English core or any package.
behavioral_boundary.prompt_spoofing: Destination-like text inside the prompt cannot override the authoritative outer label.

scientific_decision: The additive extension passes its bounded mechanical construct and leaves the sealed product byte-stable and independently verifiable. It may be used by a separately governed external-artifact conformance campaign, which must produce its own quality, exclusion, lifecycle, sparsity, and performance evidence.
claim_boundary: No external artifact, acquisition, English quality, specialist quality, physical performance, memory, TTFT, semantic purity, ABI compatibility, or ABI-superiority claim is established here. The historical Phase 0-8 release is unchanged.
